clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, newly awakened Forsaken gather supplies for the recruits rising from nearby graves. Deathguard Saltain sends them to search the blighted settlement for abandoned boxes and crates, where the Forsaken must find what they need to survive.

Newly raised Forsaken wake in Deathknell with little to call their own. Deathguard Saltain sends them to gather what the recruits still climbing from their graves need: clothing and arms. The Forsaken must salvage supplies to outfit those newly risen, with every usable piece put to work.

Deathknell holds remnants of its former human inhabitants and supplies abandoned during the kingdom’s fall to the Scourge. Deathguards send newly awakened Forsaken to recover usable goods from boxes and crates scattered through the town. The Forsaken expect no charity from the living and must depend on their own effort to survive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!
Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones! I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us? There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside. No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work friend, I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
